dev.description: Polyglav self-development pipeline: investigate, implement, test, review, commit

stages.task_hint: Investigate the codebase for this task: find the files, functions, classes, and tests involved, explain how they relate, and propose a concrete solution with the ordered steps to implement it. Read only what the task needs and cite exact paths and line references so later stages do not re-read. Name the risks and any open questions. Do not edit files.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the investigation, code map, and proposed solution to the programmer.

stages.task_hint: Implement the developer's proposed solution in the Polyglav codebase, reading only the files the investigation did not cover. Edit surgically with file_edit, run the related tests with code_test then the whole suite once, lint with code_lint until they pass, then code_format. Keep changes minimal, stdlib-only, and scoped to the task. Do not commit; return a proposed commit message in the repo style.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the changed files, implementation summary, and proposed commit message to the tester.

stages.task_hint: Write or update tests for the change in tests/ (or the plugin's tests/ dir for plugin changes). Run only the related tests during the loop, then the whole suite once, and report the outcome. For each failure include the failing assertion and a short diagnosis.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the test results and failure diagnoses to the code-reviewer.

stages.task_hint: Review the implementation and tests against the developer's investigation, the plan, and AGENTS.md (stdlib-only, type hints, no comments, planning files in sync, ASCII docs, commit message style). Return findings with severity, file and line, and a suggested fix. Do not edit the code. End your answer with a single line 'VERDICT: PASS' when the change is acceptable or 'VERDICT: CHANGES' when more work is needed.
stages.handoff_note: Return the review findings as the final answer.

stages.task_hint: Land the accepted change as one commit. Inspect the tree with git (status, diff), stage only the task's files, and commit with a single-line repo-style message. Never push or amend. Report the commit hash, the message, and the files committed.
stages.handoff_note: Return the commit hash and message as the final answer.

docs.description: Polyglav documentation pipeline: scope, write, commit

stages.task_hint: Scope the documentation change against AGENTS.md doc conventions and the current state of TODO.md, PLAN.md, and CHANGELOG.md. Decide which planning files or docs change and how. Do not touch source code.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the doc scope to the docs writer.

stages.task_hint: Make the documentation change following AGENTS.md doc conventions exactly: planning-file roles, ## Done one-liners of at most 100 characters sorted newest-first, CHANGELOG as a single flat bullet list newest-first, docs-only changes get no CHANGELOG entry, ASCII punctuation only, version in pyproject.toml in sync. Commit each added task right after the operator's prompt, then work through the single points one at a time. Return the changed docs and a proposed commit message in the repo style.
stages.handoff_note: Hand the changed docs and proposed commit message to the committer.

stages.task_hint: Land the documentation change as one commit. Inspect the tree with git (status, diff), stage only the docs changed, and commit with a single-line repo-style message. Never push or amend. Report the commit hash, the message, and the files committed.
stages.handoff_note: Return the commit hash and message as the final answer.
